proof_summary: Introduce the auxiliary sequence \(c_0=2,\ c_1=56\), \(c_{n+2}=-4c_{n+1}-64c_n\), and derive a step-two recurrence \(a_{m+6}=-48a_{m+4}+3072a_{m+2}+262144a_m\). Algebra shows that \(c_n^2\) satisfies the corresponding recurrence, so agreement of the first three odd-indexed terms extends by a three-term sliding induction to \(a_{2n+1}=c_n^2\) for every \(n\).
